summary: Iter 22 — Report Permissions + YTD defaults fully verified. Backend: 15 new pytest (test_report_permissions.py) all PASS covering GET/PUT /api/reports/permissions, admin-only update, role-scoped GET response, toggle->403->re-enable round trip, empty-body 400, and default matrix access on all 7 report endpoints. Existing reports suite (test_reports.py) 30/30 still PASS. Frontend (live Playwright on preview URL): admin=7 cards + Permissions button; dialog shows 7×3 switch matrix; toggle deal-blotter trader OFF->save->persisted in DB->trader gets 403 on /api/reports/deal-blotter while admin stays 200->restore saves defaults; YTD dates (2026-01-01 .. 2026-04-28) correctly pre-filled on Deal Blotter, Settlement, Volume Summary; Open Positions has NO date filter (snapshot); CSV+PDF exports for admin and trader return 200 (no 401 regression); trader sees exactly 5 cards (no audit-trail/user-activity) and no Permissions button. Defaults restored at end of run.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py _get_report_permissions() re-reads DB on every _check_report_access() call (one DB roundtrip per report request). Low-volume today but consider a small TTL cache keyed on a version counter to avoid per-request IO once traffic scales.

server.py _check_report_access(): if a new report_id is added to endpoints but missing from DEFAULT_REPORT_PERMISSIONS/DB doc, the function returns perms.get(report_id, {}) -> access denied for everyone including admin. Consider defaulting unknown report_ids to admin:True or raising a clearer 500 'report_id not registered' error.

PUT /api/reports/permissions: audit log message is the same generic 'Updated report permissions' regardless of which toggles changed. Including the diff (or at least the affected report_ids) in log_audit detail would materially help forensics.

PermissionsDialog (ReportsPage.jsx L558): admin switch for audit-trail is disabled (good guard) but the same guardrail is NOT enforced server-side. An admin could POST {permissions:{'audit-trail':{'admin':false}}} and lock everyone out of audit-trail. Add a server-side invariant: audit-trail.admin must remain true.
PermissionsDialog fetches /reports/permissions but has no error state — if the GET fails the dialog stays on the spinner forever. Add a catch that toasts and closes the dialog.

getYTDRange() uses toISOString().slice(0,10) which converts to UTC; near midnight in negative-UTC timezones this would render tomorrow's date as 'to' and affect the from year. For an internal FX tool this is acceptable but worth a comment.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (16/16 functional checks across admin and trader)
